purpose: Round-4 evidence step: descriptive funding-carry statistics of the committed raw funding series on the IN-SAMPLE window ONLY. No strategy is executed, no hurdle is evaluated, no out-of-sample or hold-out data is read. Any strategy registered from these numbers must be pre-registered BEFORE it runs.
probe_rule: contrarian flip cycle: long while the last settled funding rate < 0, short while > 0; flip at the first 1m open strictly after the settlement whose sign differs; funding accrues at settlements at/after entry exactly per the committed engine convention (long pays r, short receives r when r > 0). The §7.2 stop/sizing layer is NOT applied in this probe.
